# Enabling direct authentication with an external OIDC identity provider {#external-auth}

Configure OpenShift Container Platform to use an external OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider directly for token-based authentication, replacing the built-in OAuth server with your organization’s existing identity infrastructure.

**Additional resources**

- [Example OIDC provider configuration for CLI clients only](/authentication/external-auth#external-auth-cli_external-auth)
- [Configuring advanced direct authentication fields](/authentication/structured-auth-config-fields#structured-auth-config-fields)
